basic_details.job_title: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department Karur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Multi Purpose Helper, IT Worker Posts
basic_details.short_information: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, Karur District invites offline applications from eligible female candidates belonging to Karur District for 3 posts on a temporary consolidated pay basis at the Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC-181), operating 24X7 in shift systems (3X8). Applications typed with complete personal bio-data must reach the District Social Welfare Office, District Collectorate Campus, Karur District between 26.10.2026 and 09.11.2026 before 05.45 PM.

content_sections.heading: About Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department Karur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC-181) under the Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment in Karur District operates 24X7 to support women in distress. The positions announced by District Collector Thiru C. Muthukumaran, I.A.S., are engaged on a temporary consolidated pay basis to deliver operational and technical services in continuous 3X8 shifts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible female candidates should type their detailed bio-data as per the model application format available on the official website (https://karur.nic.in) and enclose all required self-attested certificates. Completed applications must be delivered so as to reach the designated office on or before 09.11.2026 by 05.45 PM at the following address: District Social Welfare Officer, District Social Welfare Office, District Collectorate Campus, Karur District - 639 007 FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The detailed eligibility and terms applicable to each post are as follows: Gender & Nativity: Only female candidates native to Karur District are eligible. Educational Qualification: Must possess a Postgraduate / Graduate degree in Social Work, Psychology, Development Studies, or Sociology. Experience: Must have 3 years of work experience in Government or Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs). Age Limit: Within 40 years of age. Nature of Work: Temporary engagement on consolidated pay on a 24X7 basis working under rotational shifts (3X8). Gender & Nativity: Only female candidates native to Karur District are eligible. Educational Qualification: Must possess a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering from a recognized university, with computer study qualification and Senior Grade (முதுநிலை) typewriting certification in both Tamil and English. Experience: Must have 3 years of work experience in Government or Non-Governmental Organisations (NGOs). Age Limit: Within 40 years of age. Nature of Work: Temporary engagement on consolidated pay on a 24X7 basis working under rotational shifts (3X8). Candidates should verify the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility details for each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: As indicated in the official application format, candidates must enclose supporting document proofs for the following items: Proof of Date of Birth Family Income Certificate (obtained from Tahsildar) Fitness Certificate (obtained from Government Medical Officer) Proof of Educational Qualification Proof of Additional Qualification (if any) Community Certificate Proof of Working Experience

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department Karur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are announced, comprising 2 posts of Case Worker (வழக்கு பணியாளர்கள்) and 1 post of Information Technology Worker (தகவல் தொழில்நுட்ப பணியாளர்).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The typed application along with necessary enclosures must reach the District Social Welfare Office on or before 09.11.2026 by 05.45 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are native to Karur District and meet the educational and experience criteria are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be within 40 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay for Case Worker?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated pay for the Case Worker post is Rs. 18,800/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly pay for Information Technology Worker?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated pay for the Information Technology Worker post is Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for the Information Technology Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a recognized Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, along with Senior Grade typing in Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q8. Is this job permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The positions are engaged purely on a temporary consolidated pay basis for the 24X7 operations of the Sakhi One Stop Centre (OSC-181) under 3X8 shift systems.
